title: Karhutla drill — Segati, Kabupaten Pelalawan
summary: Twenty simulated citizen reports of a peatland fire (karhutla) at Segati, Pelalawan, plus Bunut and Teluk Meranti, and two old urban-fire photo claims that should stay out of the confirmed cluster.
ethics: All photos are drawn placeholders. Voice files are tones plus transcripts, not field recordings.

reports.text: Karhutla di Segati, Pelalawan. Lahan gambut terbakar, asap tebal. Sekitar 80 jiwa terdampak, butuh damkar.
reports.translation_en: Forest and land fire in Segati, Pelalawan. Peatland is burning, smoke is thick. About 80 people affected, need firefighters.
reports.transcript: Karhutla di Segati, Pelalawan. Lahan gambut terbakar, asap tebal. Sekitar 80 jiwa terdampak, butuh damkar.

reports.text: Foto asap di Segati. Api menjalar ke tepi kebun, jarak pandang sangat buruk.
reports.translation_en: Smoke photo in Segati. Fire is spreading to the edge of the plantation, visibility is very poor.
reports.transcript: Foto asap di Segati. Api menjalar ke tepi kebun, jarak pandang sangat buruk.
Tolong, kebakaran lahan gambut di Segati. Asap tebal, 20 rumah terancam. Butuh truk tangki dan evakuasi.
reports.text: Tolong, kebakaran lahan gambut di Segati. Asap tebal, 20 rumah terancam. Butuh truk tangki dan evakuasi.
reports.translation_en: Please help, peatland fire in Segati. Thick smoke, 20 houses threatened. Need tank trucks and evacuation.

reports.text: WA: sama seperti voice tadi, kebakaran lahan di Segati, 20 rumah terancam, butuh damkar sekarang.
reports.translation_en: WhatsApp: same as the voice note, land fire in Segati, 20 houses threatened, need firefighters now.
reports.transcript: WA: sama seperti voice tadi, kebakaran lahan di Segati, 20 rumah terancam, butuh damkar sekarang.

reports.text: Karhutla Segati, sekitar 80 jiwa. Sekolah tutup karena asap. Warga butuh masker dan air minum.
reports.translation_en: Karhutla in Segati, about 80 people. School closed because of smoke. Residents need masks and drinking water.
reports.transcript: Karhutla Segati, sekitar 80 jiwa. Sekolah tutup karena asap. Warga butuh masker dan air minum.
Ngapunten, geni ing Segati wis cedhak omah. Ana wong tuwa sing sesuk ora bisa ambegan. Butuh obat lan masker.
reports.text: Ngapunten, geni ing Segati wis cedhak omah. Ana wong tuwa sing sesuk ora bisa ambegan. Butuh obat lan masker.
reports.translation_en: Sorry, the fire in Segati is already near the houses. An elderly person is struggling to breathe. Need medicine and masks.

reports.text: PetaBencana report: peatland fire hotspot cluster near Segati, Pelalawan. Smoke reducing visibility on the main road.
reports.translation_en: PetaBencana report: peatland fire hotspot cluster near Segati, Pelalawan. Smoke reducing visibility on the main road.
reports.transcript: PetaBencana report: peatland fire hotspot cluster near Segati, Pelalawan. Smoke reducing visibility on the main road.

reports.text: Grup RT: ulang, 80 jiwa terdampak karhutla Segati, 20 rumah terancam. Mohon logistik masker.
reports.translation_en: Neighborhood group: repeating, 80 people affected by the Segati karhutla, 20 houses threatened. Please send mask supplies.
reports.transcript: Grup RT: ulang, 80 jiwa terdampak karhutla Segati, 20 rumah terancam. Mohon logistik masker.

reports.text: 3 orang terjebak asap di kebun sawit Segati. Tidak bisa keluar ke jalan utama. Butuh evakuasi.
reports.translation_en: 3 people are trapped by smoke in a Segati palm plantation. Cannot reach the main road. Need evacuation.
reports.transcript: 3 orang terjebak asap di kebun sawit Segati. Tidak bisa keluar ke jalan utama. Butuh evakuasi.

reports.text: Api menjalar ke permukiman Segati. Butuh pemadam dan truk tangki air dari Manggala Agni.
reports.translation_en: Fire is spreading into Segati settlement. Need firefighters and water tank trucks from Manggala Agni.
reports.transcript: Api menjalar ke permukiman Segati. Butuh pemadam dan truk tangki air dari Manggala Agni.

reports.text: Saya di titik yang sama dengan laporan pertama. Karhutla Segati masih aktif, lansia sesak napas belum tertolong.
reports.translation_en: I am at the same spot as the first report. Segati karhutla still active, the elderly person with breathing trouble has not been helped.
reports.transcript: Saya di titik yang sama dengan laporan pertama. Karhutla Segati masih aktif, lansia sesak napas belum tertolong.

reports.text: Kebakaran lahan di Bunut, asap mulai masuk kampung. Sekitar 35 jiwa terdampak, belum ada yang terjebak.
reports.translation_en: Land fire in Bunut, smoke is entering the village. About 35 people affected, nobody trapped yet.
reports.transcript: Kebakaran lahan di Bunut, asap mulai masuk kampung. Sekitar 35 jiwa terdampak, belum ada yang terjebak.

reports.text: Foto asap Bunut dari jalan desa. Api masih di lahan, belum mengepung rumah.
reports.translation_en: Smoke photo from the Bunut village road. Fire is still in the field, has not surrounded houses.
reports.transcript: Foto asap Bunut dari jalan desa. Api masih di lahan, belum mengepung rumah.

reports.text: Duplikat grup: Bunut asap tebal, 35 jiwa. Mohon dicatat satu laporan saja.
reports.translation_en: Group duplicate: Bunut thick smoke, 35 people. Please log as one report.
reports.transcript: Duplikat grup: Bunut asap tebal, 35 jiwa. Mohon dicatat satu laporan saja.

reports.text: PetaBencana: land-fire report Bunut, Pelalawan. Road still open to high vehicles.
reports.translation_en: PetaBencana: land-fire report in Bunut, Pelalawan. Road still open to high vehicles.
reports.transcript: PetaBencana: land-fire report Bunut, Pelalawan. Road still open to high vehicles.

reports.text: Asap dari kebakaran lahan di Teluk Meranti. Sekitar 18 jiwa terganggu napas, butuh masker.
reports.translation_en: Smoke from a land fire in Teluk Meranti. About 18 people with breathing trouble, need masks.
reports.transcript: Asap dari kebakaran lahan di Teluk Meranti. Sekitar 18 jiwa terganggu napas, butuh masker.

reports.text: Duplikat: Teluk Meranti asap, 18 jiwa. Sama dengan laporan warga tadi.
reports.translation_en: Duplicate: Teluk Meranti smoke, 18 people. Same as the earlier citizen report.
reports.transcript: Duplikat: Teluk Meranti asap, 18 jiwa. Sama dengan laporan warga tadi.

reports.translation_en: HUGE FIRE in Segati! Forward this now before the whole village is gone!

reports.transcript: API BESAR Segati! Sebarkan sekarang sebelum seluruh desa habis!

reports.translation_en: Segati fire photo from last night in the group. Share to every RT.
